title: Technology and Precision Health
description: This course will introduce students to the field of precision health and will provide a broad overview of a variety of emerging technologies (artificial intelligence, informatics, big data and data science, genomics, spatial data, digital health, predictive analytics). Students will be prompted to consider the applications to public health policy and practice. Prerequisites: must be enrolled in MPH program (PB75 and PB90) or program approval. Renumbered from FMPH 430. Students may not receive credit for both FMPH 430 and PH 430.
